title: Preserve keyboard focus when checkpoint chooser groups change
outcome: Marker regrouping or viewport resize does not silently strand focus on document.body while the checkpoint chooser is open.
acceptance: Add a behavior test that opens a group chooser, then changes its first marker or group membership through marker updates or viewport regrouping.
When the active group disappears or changes, restore focus to a surviving dot or the conversation container and retain correct chooser/navigation state.
